units.cutoverBoundary: Freeze one checkpoint, stop all five compat Feishu streams, import pending message/card/projection state, then start the five native streams exactly once.
units.rollback: Stop every native stream before restoring the frozen compat checkpoint and bridge-compat process.

units.cutoverBoundary: Disable compat overdue and completed-task timers, migrate notification fingerprints and cleanup cursor, then enable the native scheduled plugin.
units.rollback: Disable the native timer before restoring migrated fingerprints and re-enabling compat timers.

units.cutoverBoundary: Pause compat follow-up polling, migrate open outreach approvals and last workday checkpoint, then enable the native workflow.
units.rollback: Stop native polling, export unresolved approvals back to the frozen compat schema, then resume compat polling.

units.cutoverBoundary: Pause Xiaowei request/reply polling, migrate every pending correlation and approval, then resume through one native channel owner.
units.rollback: Stop native Xiaowei polling and restore only unresolved correlations to compat before resuming it.

units.cutoverBoundary: Pause archive/delete sweeps, migrate session ownership, Dida completion links and retry deadlines, then enable native cleanup.
units.rollback: Stop native cleanup before restoring remaining session records; never replay already-completed deletes.

units.cutoverBoundary: Pause learning evaluation, import privacy-bounded observations and proposal cooldowns, then enable native policy learning.
units.rollback: Disable native evaluation and restore only observations newer than the frozen compat checkpoint by stable sample id.
